transcript: Your mind is slowly ruining your life and you don't even notice it. You have around 6,000 thoughts every single day and most of them you don't even choose. You just let them run. You overthink the worst case. You replay problems that didn't even happen yet. You imagine failure again and again. Even I sometimes overthink. Sometimes I feel stressed too. I am the same human as you. But one day I realize something simple. If I can overthink the worst, I can also overthink the best. If your mind is powerful enough to create fear that isn't real, it is also powerful enough to create peace that is not here yet. So why not use it differently? Imagine things going right. Imagine yourself calm. Imagine the life you actually want because your mind is always creating something, whether you realize it or not. So out of those 6,000 thoughts today, choose better ones, not perfect ones, just better ones. And if you're ready to take control of your mind, comment peace below.
